name: Brother Anton

chain: In the Name of the Light

summary: In Nijel's Point, Brother Anton seeks help against the undead in Desolace. He came from distant lands after hearing of the threat.

sections.title: A Brother Abroad
sections.body: Rumors of undead in Desolace reached Brother Anton in far-off Kalimdor. He booked passage at once to seek them out and destroy them. Now he looks for people with courage and resolve. If your heart is true, Brother Crowley sends you to find him in Nijel's Point, the Alliance town in Desolace.

sections.title: Word from the East
sections.body: Brother Anton has heard that aid is coming from the east. He asks whether you brought those rumors and whether you have come to help with the Scarlet Brother's crusade.

faq.answer: Brother Anton is Brother Crowley's brother in arms. When he heard undead were infesting Desolace, he booked passage there to destroy them.

faq.q: Where can Brother Anton be found?
faq.answer: Brother Anton can be found in Nijel's Point, the Alliance town in Desolace.

faq.q: Why did Brother Anton go to Kalimdor?
faq.answer: Rumors of undead in Desolace, in Kalimdor, reached Brother Anton. He booked passage at once to destroy them.
